subject: Flagship booth: casework specs, vertical graphics & production order

From: Linda Park <linda@atlas-expo.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Sep 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas quote + draft build options for Redwood flagship

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the walk-through yesterday. Attached is our updated quote (atlas_vendor_quote_v2.xlsx) and three build options for the 20x30 island:
- Option A: Standard casework + single-sided 30ft vertical graphic (lower cost)
- Option B: Modular casework with integrated demo counters + double vertical graphics (sightline-friendly)
- Option C: Premium casework (custom laminate) + enclosed storage + double-gable mast (highest production time)

Lead time for Options B/C is ~12 business days after art approval; A is 8 days. We can do overnight crating for the West Hall at an extra cost shown in the quote.

Quick notes: the venue has a 16ft rigging height for inline islands (per CloudCon ops) — if you want the 30ft vertical, we recommend a free-standing anchored billboard rather than hung signage.

If you can confirm the option today we’ll finalize shop drawings and start build.

Best,
Linda Park
Atlas Expo Services
